title: Command palette
purpose: The ⌘K command palette is a modal overlay over the main window that lets the user run any app command, or jump to a list in the active project or any project, by typing part of its label. Results are grouped under View, Task, Manage, Go to list and Go to project, and the list filters live as the user types.

widgets.behaviour: Typing sets q and resets the active row to 0. The list is filtered by case-insensitive substring match on the label (not fuzzy) and ranked by match index, earlier matches first, stable. ArrowDown moves active down, capped at results.length-1; with zero results it becomes -1 and nothing is highlighted. ArrowUp moves active up, floored at 0. Enter runs the active row; the default key is prevented for these keys. Enter with no results does nothing.

notes:
Merged from inventory A (code) and inventory B (measurements) after the critique.

Conflicts resolved per the critique:
- Palette panel geometry: A's values used (490 px wide at x=345, y=91; heights 456/184/109). B's 488 wide at x=346, y=92 measured the row width, not the panel. B's panel corner radius and soft shadow are kept as visual notes only.
- Palette-search icons: 16x16 (A and the critic). B's 18x18 claim is dropped.
- Scrim click: dismisses the palette (A, verified by onMouseDown on Backdrop2 and onDismiss on Overlay). B's "unverified" wording is superseded.
- Placeholder: single ellipsis character "…" (code and tree), not three periods as in B.
- Group headings: all five palette-state headings (View, Task, Manage, Go to list, Go to project) are kept, as the critic says the tree records both Go headings. B's section-header kind is merged into A's label kind and component Label (as="div").
- Jump-row labels (Errands, Reading, Garden, Home, Spring launch) are taken from B's elements.json and kept as runtime text in the no-hotkey MenuItem entry.

Merged matches: Scrim (Backdrop2), Palette panel (Surface2), input row with divider, bolt icon, text input, results list, group headings (Label as div), empty message (Label as p), hotkey and no-hotkey MenuItem rows, row icons, HotkeyHint. Looks from B are attached to A's components.

Dropped:
- B's "Dimmed app window behind scrim" widget and its region: main-window content (TitleBar, TaskPane, PreviewPanel, Resizer), out of scope for the palette, per the critic.
- B's separate "Divider" widget: folded into the input row (border-b), per the critic.
- B's separate section-header widgets for VIEW, TASK and MANAGE: merged into the single label widget.
- B's separate jump-to list and project row widgets: merged into the no-hotkey MenuItem entry (same component and variant).

Unverified in both inventories: Overlay, Backdrop2, Surface, TextInput, MenuItem, HotkeyHint and Label implementations were not read, so hover, focus, pressed and disabled looks and the exact Escape behaviour are unconfirmed. The ⌘K opener binding and how the palette is opened were not captured. Link targets marked inferred (draft-inspector, sheets, trash, settings-general pane, collapse/expand targets) were not observed.
